customer_message.subject: chat – mould and floor heating
customer_message.body:
Chloe Brennan: hi, I rent a 2.5-room at Schulhausstrasse 62 in Liestal, Verwaltung Lindenhof Treuhand
Chloe Brennan: we have condensation running down the walls and mould on all the window frames. it's getting worse every week
Chloe Brennan: and the floor in the living area is stone cold, the underfloor heating there hasn't come on at all since spring, the thermostat just blinks
Chloe Brennan: Lindenhof says the mould is because we don't air enough. I think it's the walls. the guy from the tenants' association said with a dispute like that you need an expert to check where the damp comes from
Chloe Brennan: my flatmate has been ill a lot lately, coughing and tired, but honestly we don't know if that's the flat or just her job at the daycare
Chloe Brennan: I'm not going to stop paying rent or put it in a deposit thing, I don't want trouble. I just want them to fix it
Chloe Brennan: attaching my letter from May and their reply. they promised a caretaker visit in September, he came for 5 minutes
